svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Deposit flow: fiat to USDC / USDT0 / EURC on Stellar
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of a deposit between the client, Stablecue, the Anchor Platform partner and the Stellar network, with the Stablecue intent state shown at each stage.
svg.text: Deposit flow: fiat to USDC / USDT0 / EURC on Stellar
signed in the client’s own wallet
Every state transition is appended to the immutable event log: intent_id → partner transaction id → Stellar tx hash.
Solid arrows: requests and actions. Dashed arrows: responses and callbacks. Arrow colour = sender (teal client, indigo Stablecue, amber partner, grey Stellar).
